theMechanismReadOutOfTheSource.whereTheModeledStudyActuallyComesFrom: engine-api, route GET|POST /v1/property-nodes/{parcelNodeId}/flood-drainage/{study,refresh}. In Property Explorer that route is reached through apps/property-explorer/api/_lib/pe-flood-drainage-handler.ts, which additionally enforces a paid PROPERTY entitlement (PE session + per-property unlock or Pro) via resolveFloodDrainageAuth. The ENTITLEMENT is a commercial gate on a different product; the TRANSPORT is the same for both callers -- engine-api's gate middleware is global (server.ts app.use('*') bearer + gate-front; v1.use('*') gate-context), and there are NO flood-drainage MCP tools. That is why a direct server-side client here is a transport reuse and not a second data path.
theMechanismReadOutOfTheSource.theTwoEnvironmentVariables: HAUSKA_ENGINE_BASE and HAUSKA_ENGINE_API_KEY. NO default and NO fallback, which is src/platform-base.mjs's law applied to a second upstream: an unset base is a per-parcel refusal carrying its basis, never a host. The engine key is the same secret the retrieval/PE/BFF paths already hold (scripts/inventory-key-consumers.mjs enumerates the holders in doc_repo); the BASE is the part that does not exist in this product's env today, and whether the deployed app sets it is an OPEN thread in this checkpoint rather than an assumption.
theMechanismReadOutOfTheSource.theParcelIdentityIsTheWholeBridge: parcelNodeId is {countyFips}:{propId} (PE validates it with isValidParcelNodeId and its own error text is 'parcelNodeId must match {fips}:{propId}, e.g. 48029:105129'). A live Bastrop MyGov permit carries place.parcelNodeId = row.parcelId (src/mygov-permits.mjs:123), which on the real sample row is the bare prop id '33383' -- the FIPS is NOT a field on the row. parcelNodeIdFor() therefore takes the FIPS from the caller and REFUSES, with a basis, when either half is missing, rather than assuming 48021.
theMechanismReadOutOfTheSource.theDepthBound: rainfallDepthInches is a bare depth in (0, 60]. The engine's own rejection text is 'rainfallDepthInches must be a number in (0, 60].'; mirrored verbatim as DEPTH_BOUND_BASIS. There is NO storm duration in the contract and none was added.
theMechanismReadOutOfTheSource.theReturnPeriodPairing: The engine pairs return period to depth through study.rainfallCurve (NOAA Atlas 14). Its own design storm renders as '100-yr (NOAA Atlas 14)'; a depth passed in the request renders as 'approximately N-yr equivalent (interpolated)'. rainfallBasisLabel() names WHICH of the two a reader is looking at and returns an unlabelled refusal for an unknown rainfallSource rather than defaulting to NOAA. The interpolation is log-linear over the curve, ported from the client's returnPeriodYearsForDepthInches so the control and the engine's own PDF label cannot disagree.
theMechanismReadOutOfTheSource.theFailureClasses: engine_timeout and engine_unreachable are the ONLY retryable classes (mirrored from the source's retryableErrorField), each carrying the engine's own copy so a timeout cannot be softened into a result. engine_gate_config and engine_refused are NOT retryable: a 502 that means 'gate misconfigured' and a 502 that means 'the engine was restarting' are different results, and collapsing them is how a config error becomes an infinite Retry button.
theMechanismReadOutOfTheSource.theThreeEmptyStatesThatMustNotCollapse: study.honestEmpty -> the engine ran and DECLINED, its reason rendered verbatim; a study with a zero ponding share -> NO_PONDING_LINE; a study whose share cannot be read -> 'unmeasured'. Plus queued/running, which are not results at all. studyViewState() is ONE function so the order cannot drift, and honestEmpty is checked BEFORE any ponding arithmetic because an honestEmpty study carries no geometry to measure.

theFalsifiersAsBuilt.claim: An engine that did not answer is not a parcel that does not pond (design trap 4).
theFalsifiersAsBuilt.asserted: A transport throw classifies as engine_unreachable and stays retryable end to end; an aborted run classifies as engine_timeout, retryable, ponding 'not-measured', and its basis is asserted NOT to equal NO_PONDING_LINE. A 500 and a 401 are asserted NOT retryable.

theFalsifiersAsBuilt.claim: The basis line says WHICH pair a reader sees, and the two DIVERGE (design trap 2).
theFalsifiersAsBuilt.asserted: source noaa-atlas14 renders ENGINE_DESIGN_STORM_LABEL; source parameter renders /^approx N-yr equivalent (interpolated)$/; the two labels are asserted NOT equal (the paired control's divergence test). An unknown source and a parameter depth with no curve both refuse to label rather than defaulting to NOAA.

theFalsifiersAsBuilt.claim: honestEmpty, zero ponding and unmeasured are three states, not one (design trap 3).
theFalsifiersAsBuilt.asserted: honestEmpty renders its reason verbatim and has no NO_PONDING_LINE; zero share renders NO_PONDING_LINE; an unreadable share renders 'unmeasured' and is asserted NOT 'none'; honestEmpty with no reason is a named absence rather than an empty string.

theFalsifiersAsBuilt.claim: The G-130 ruling is a refused affordance on the ZONE card (design trap 5).

theFalsifiersAsBuilt.claim: A parcel whose identity cannot be built is a ROW with a basis, never a missing row (Move 1).

whatIsNotBuiltAndThisIsTheHonestHalf: THE SCREEN. The tab at web/index.html#tab-flood-study is still the placeholder paragraph plus the G-129 'Open on the map' button. Nothing in web/ renders the screening list, the depth control, the two cards or the refusal, so all five artboards (screening, one parcel, depth comparison, running, unavailable) are accounted for in the MODEL and drawn by NOBODY. This is the larger half of the lane.
THE ROUTE. src/server.mjs has no /api/lenses/development-services/flood-study handler, so nothing serves the model to a browser yet.

THE PARCEL BRIDGE'S COUNTY FIPS. Nothing in this product supplies the county FIPS that parcelNodeIdFor() requires. bastrop_tx is Bastrop County (48021) and the product already hardcodes Bastrop ArcGIS services, but deriving the FIPS from the pack is a decision with a source, not a constant to type in, so it is left refusing.

THE PONDING SHARE'S FIELD NAME. pondingSharePercent() reads study.stats.pondingPercent / .pondingSharePercent /.pondingShare, taken from the design's facts, which name stats but NOT the key. It has NOT been confirmed against a live engine payload. Reading only keys that could be verified means the screen will say 'unmeasured' rather than report a confident zero until someone reads a real study -- which is the correct failure direction and is called out here rather than papered over.
